name: Birria Tacos
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup white onion (diced, for garnish $0.16)
¼ cup fresh cilantro (coriander) (chopped, for garnish $0.20)

recipeInstructions.text: Pat dry the chuck roast and season all over with salt and pepper.
recipeInstructions.name: Season

recipeInstructions.text: Add the beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, beef broth, tomato paste, diced chipotle pepper, spices, and bay leaves to a slow cooker (mine is 6-quarts). Cover and cook on low for 6–8 hours or high for 4–5 hours until the beef is fall-apart tender.***
recipeInstructions.name: Cook

recipeInstructions.text: Remove bay leaves and shred the meat directly in the slow cooker.
recipeInstructions.name: Shred

recipeInstructions.text: Ladle some broth (consomé) into a bowl. Lightly dip both sides of a tortilla into it.****
recipeInstructions.name: Dip

recipeInstructions.text: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium. Place the dipped tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese on half, top with shredded birria, and fold into a taco.
recipeInstructions.name: Sprinkle

recipeInstructions.text: Cook 2–3 min per side until crispy and golden. Repeat with the remaining tacos.
recipeInstructions.name: Cook

recipeInstructions.text: Serve your birria tacos hot with small bowls of consomé for dipping. Garnish with diced onion, cilantro, and lime wedges.
recipeInstructions.name: Serve
